name: admin-python-prepare-for-migration-refuses-without-the-operator-header-403
description: POST /admin/prepare-for-migration without `Coherence-Local-Operator: true` is refused 403 before anything drains. Bearer alone is not enough: the header is the operator opt-in /status?detail=full also requires.

body.error: prepare-for-migration requires the Coherence-Local-Operator: true opt-in header (operator-only endpoint).
